svg.title: Target-only states on full and fully-fitting support
svg.desc: Stacked bars show query-macro Always, VI and Never for full and encoder-specific fully-fitting target populations. The full C0 competitor catalog is retained. Query and highest-relevance pair denominators appear beside each bar. WANDS uses the existing held-out split and ESCI the existing evaluation sample. Full-minus-fitting differences are descriptive, not causal truncation effects.
